annotation.kind: faithfulness rebuild of the all-prefix CGS-P execution, Theorem 1(7), and its explicit finite second-order remainder

assumptions: The dimensions m and n are positive, n <= m, and the real m-by-n input A has full column rank.
One proof-carrying successful normalized-range Algorithm 2 (CGS-P) trace links the common computed Q and upper-triangular R to every column step, including the pythagorean diagonal formula.
The machine unit satisfies 0 < epsilonM < 1; named local pseudo-code errors have finite first-order envelopes because the paper does not fix complete primitive evaluation orders.
Every leading R_k has a certified two-sided inverse, and the strict condition c4(m,k)*epsilonM*kappa2(R_k)^2 < 1 holds for all positive prefixes.
For every prefix, equations (4)-(5) and the reversed norm comparison used from (6) hold in the spectral 2-norm with separate explicit nonnegative coefficients multiplying epsilonM^2.
Only successful normalized finite real executions are modeled; breakdown and IEEE exceptional-value behavior left unspecified by the paper are outside the claim.

conditions.L: The identical fixed statement and P11 shared files are present; the frozen NumStability library is also present.
conditions.N: The fixed statement and P11 shared files are present; no NumStability artifact is present.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p11_t3_orthogonality_defect_bound {m n : Nat} (run : P11CGSPTheorem1Run m n) : forall k : Fin n, p11OpNorm2 (p11RectOrthogonalityDefect (p11ColumnPrefix run.Q k)) <= p11C4 m (k.val+1) * p11Kappa2 (p11LeadingBlock run.R k) (run.leadingInverse k)^2 * run.epsilonM + p11Theorem1OrthogonalityRemainderCoeff run k * run.epsilonM^2
formal_statement.plain_language: Every positive prefix of one successful rectangular CGS-P execution satisfies Theorem 1(7)'s spectral loss-of-orthogonality bound with exact leading coefficient c4(m,k)*kappa2(R_k)^2 and an explicit finite second-order remainder.

informal_proof: For each prefix, derive the exact page-312 inverse-conjugated identity from Q_k R_k=A_k+DeltaA_k and the certified inverse. Apply spectral transpose invariance, triangle inequalities, and submultiplicativity to obtain the paper's intermediate norm estimate. Substitute (4)-(5), use 0<epsilonM<1 to collect all hidden and quadratic terms into epsilonM^2, apply the reversed form of (6) to replace ||A_k||_2^2 by ||R_k||_2^2 to first order, and identify the leading factor as c4(m,k)*kappa2(R_k)^2.
informal_statement: Theorem 1(7) for every prefix produced by the linked CGS-P execution, retaining the rectangular dimensions, strict condition (3), spectral norm, exact constants, computed R_k condition number, and an explicit finite interpretation of O(epsilonM squared).
